data.content_ref: inline:The covering principle is information-theoretic: the grounded labeling is the maximal fixed point that preserves the attack graph's directed acyclic skeleton of defeat, and every post-hoc diagnostic (SRC_002, SRC_003, SRC_004, SRC_008) is a lossy compression of that skeleton. DefenseWitness compresses accepted defenders; fragility compresses edge-sensitivity; suspend_reason and RESIDUE compress suspended-node causality. The neighbourhood's edge-construction enrichments (SRC_005, SRC_006, SRC_011) are exactly the operations that refine this skeleton before compression. REFUTED IF a diagnostic can distinguish two graphs that share the same defeat skeleton, or if an enrichment changes the labeling without changing the skeleton.
